answer_verbatim:
If you want the **best online courses** for shadow work and spiritual practice, the strongest options in your results are **Jung Platform’s _Encounters with the Shadow_**, **Awake Academy’s _Embracing The Shadow_**, and **ManTalks’ _Shadow Course_** because they are explicitly framed as deeper, structured shadow-work offerings rather than short generic self-help classes.[7][18][20]

A practical way to choose is:

| Best for | Course | Why it stands out |
|---|---|---|
| **Jungian depth / psychology** | **Encounters with the Shadow** (Jung Platform) | It is described as an in-depth introduction to Jungian shadow work and part of a broader Jungian psychology series.[7][16] |
| **Spiritual transformation / guided practice** | **Embracing The Shadow** (Awake Academy) | The course is presented as highly transformative and focused on personal growth and relationships, which fits a spiritually oriented practice.[18] |
| **Structured shadow-work process** | **Shadow Course: Discover Your Hidden Potential** (ManTalks) | It is an 8-week guided process for facing and integrating the shadow.[20] |
| **Journal-based self-study** | **Shadow Work Journal** (ManTalks Training) | It emphasizes journaling techniques for self-discovery, which is useful if you want a lighter, reflective entry point.[1] |
| **Live, practical, beginner-friendly format** | **Shadow Work | Online Courses** (Catherine Liggett) | It is a 5-week live Zoom course focused on practical techniques for healing from the inside out.[6] |

A few other options in the results are worth considering if you want a broader or more affordable style of learning:

- **Udemy’s _Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self_** and related shadow-work classes appear to emphasize self-mastery and spiritual awakening, but the results shown are less detailed than the specialized offerings above.[3][9][15][17]
- **Centre of Excellence’s _Shadow Mastery Diploma Course_** is explicitly inspired by Jungian psychology and modern personal development, which may appeal if you want a more formal certificate-style course.[4]
- **The Kink Academy’s _Becoming Whole: A Shadow Work & Self-Acceptance Course_** is a 4-week all-levels course, which could suit beginners looking for a shorter, guided introduction.[5]

If your goal is **spiritual practice plus depth**, I would rank them like this:

1. **Encounters with the Shadow** — best overall for Jungian shadow work depth.[7][16]  
2. **Embracing The Shadow** — best for transformational spiritual practice.[18]  
3. **Shadow Course** by ManTalks — best for a structured guided journey.[20]  
4. **Shadow Work | Catherine Liggett** — best live, practical option.[6]  
5. **Shadow Work Journal** — best low-pressure starting point.[1]  

If you want, I can also narrow these down by **price, beginner-friendliness, live vs self-paced, or spiritual tradition**.
